2026_03_LAR_DEN.headline: Rams pressure package puts Denver’s protection plan at the center of Week 3
2026_03_LAR_DEN.paragraph1: Los Angeles arrives with a defensive front capable of forcing hurried decisions, making Denver’s protection and early-down efficiency central to the matchup. The Broncos need to avoid long-yardage situations that let the Rams attack the pocket, while Denver’s defense has to keep Los Angeles from turning favorable field position into explosive scoring drives. For the Rams, sustaining pressure without sacrificing coverage discipline is the clearest route to controlling the game’s tempo.
2026_03_LAR_DEN.model_rationale: Los Angeles can dictate the matchup by creating predictable passing downs, while Denver needs disciplined protection and efficient early-down offense to keep the Rams from controlling tempo.
